mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM salary_records sr JOIN companies c ON c.company_id = sr.company_id JOIN job_categories jc ON jc.job_category_id = sr.job_category_id WHERE
SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalCount, COALESCE(SUM(status = '정상'), 0) AS normalCount, COALESCE(SUM(status = '숨김'), 0) AS hiddenCount, COALESCE(SUM(status = '삭제'), 0) AS deletedCount FROM salary_records

SELECT sr.*, c.company_name AS companyName, jc.category_name AS categoryName FROM salary_records sr JOIN companies c ON c.company_id = sr.company_id JOIN job_categories jc ON jc.job_category_id = sr.job_category_id WHERE sr.salary_record_id = #{salaryRecordId}
SELECT DISTINCT c.company_id AS companyId, c.company_name AS companyName FROM salary_records sr JOIN companies c ON c.company_id = sr.company_id ORDER BY c.company_name

SELECT DISTINCT jc.job_category_id AS jobCategoryId, jc.category_name AS categoryName FROM salary_records sr JOIN job_categories jc ON jc.job_category_id = sr.job_category_id ORDER BY jc.category_name
mapper.update: UPDATE salary_records SET status = #{status}, hidden_reason = CASE WHEN #{status} = '숨김' THEN #{hiddenReason} ELSE NULL END, hidden_by = CASE WHEN #{status} = '숨김' THEN #{adminId} ELSE NULL END, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE salary_record_id = #{salaryRecordId}
